svg.title: R3. The 434-hour run: OD600 and the photometer reference channel
svg.desc: Two panels over 434 hours at 22 C. Top: in-line OD600. Bottom: the photometer reference channel. The process event (120-160 h) and the instrument event (215-300 h) are shaded; the trust-layer alarm at 216.3 h and the start of unusable OD at 243.0 h are marked.
